Prompt decks

One deck per exam prompt: the cards picked for it on the Prompt cards page, in the order you would say them.

Section A (3 cards per question and context deck): opening → the ad → your situation and what you want → the offer, fit, experience, time, place, money, process → worries, safety, trust → reacting and closing.
Section B (8 cards per argument and context deck): opening → your situation → describing the offer → the pitch → checking in and acknowledging the objection → answering money, time, ability, hassle, trust, fear → inviting, first step, closing.
Inside each part, best score first. The back highlights the part to say for this ad. In a deck, new shows only the cards you have not met in an earlier deck, if you study the decks in list order.

Card front: the literal English, then what an American would say. Back: the French. In a deck, press e to edit a card, Esc when done; T1-T4 filter by original tier. Progress is per prompt deck and saved in this browser only.
